core_obligations: Forward (proof lines 1056-1067): if Gamma proves A and Delta is a complete consistent extension, A must lie in Delta - otherwise Delta holds not-A by maximality and proves both, contradicting consistency through the cited structural facts.

Converse (lines 1105-1110): if Gamma fails to prove A, the extension Gamma + {not A} is consistent, Lindenbaum completes it to a Delta still missing A - the witness that A is not in every maximal extension.
proof_roadmap: Maximality converts absence into negated membership.
Non-derivability yields a maximal refuting witness via Lindenbaum.
